name: CAA Generator
description: Generate CAA records that restrict which CAs may issue certificates for your domain.

hints.issue: `issue` controls ordinary certificates; `issuewild` only controls wildcard ones.
hints.iodef: `iodef` points at a reporting address, usually a `mailto:` mailbox.
hints.ttl: A TTL of 0 emits lines without a TTL, leaving it to the zone default.

faq.q: Does a CAA record block all other CAs?
faq.a: Yes. CAs not listed under `issue` must not issue for the domain.

faq.q: Do wildcard certificates need their own authorization?
faq.a: Yes. `issue` alone does not constrain wildcards; add `issuewild` to restrict them.

faq.q: What happens without a CAA record?
faq.a: Any CA may issue. Adding CAA deliberately narrows that down.
